where: Stock interior (rooms where something is wrong; Hollowing-touched places) — first heard in Hollowfen Stillworks, Coldfog Marches
mood: Cold Hearth — glass tones and a music box winding down in a room the warmth has left; eerie, beautiful, and strangely gentle.
_note: Same cue as the classic spec (assets/audio/midi/specs/interior-unease.json): 66 BPM 4/4, C# minor with whole-tone colour, no motif conditioning (the classic keeps only the motif's rising leap, unresolved). Sparse by design, but a held tone is always sounding.
_stall_note: deliberately sparse interior at 66 BPM (a bar is 3.6 s): one held-tone hush up to ~4 s is allowed; anything longer is dead air
core_styles: 16-bit console RPG soundtrack from the mid-1990s
retro sampled-chip instruments with the warm echo of a 16-bit sound chip
C# minor with whole-tone and augmented chord colour
glass harmonica tones holding long eerie notes
a music box slowly winding down
a distant mechanical tick and soft clank, like old machinery
a breath of air between phrases
an abandoned works where the hearth has gone cold, eerie and beautiful, sympathetic and gentle
short room reverb, close and quiet

sections.name: Intro
sections.text: {a music box already playing, a little slow, over a low held string chord; a distant tick; a glass harmonica tone rises out of the hush}

sections.name: Main Theme
sections.text: {the haunting melody in C# minor on glass harmonica: a rising leap that reaches for home and drifts onto a whole-tone chord instead, low strings holding, the tick far away}

sections.text: {the melody again; the music box beneath it winds slowly down, its notes spacing out, a soft mechanical clank, a breath of air between the phrases}

sections.name: Bridge
sections.text: {contrast: a brief warm A major chord on the strings, like a memory of the fire, the glass tone gentle and sad, then the whole-tone colour returns}

sections.name: Main Theme Return
sections.text: {the haunting C# minor melody returns, the music box wound again; the last bar hangs on an augmented chord that leads straight back into the theme}
